description: An agent's ``policy.shield``: its pod's egress and ingress.

egress.description: What the agent's pod may reach beyond the platform's own endpoints: '*' (any public address, any TCP port) alone, or exact hosts, host:port, IPv4 addresses, CIDRs, each with an optional :port. Private and reserved addresses are refused; empty keeps the platform's endpoints only.
egress.title: Egress

ingress.description: Who may reach the agent's ports: 'platform' (the platform's ingress and probes), '*', or an address or CIDR with an optional :port (the agent's port). Empty means 'platform'.
ingress.title: Ingress

title: Agent Shield firewall rules
